title: rollouts: add evaluator/monitor metrics for auto-rollback + wire into dashboards
author: Allison Grant
release_notes: Internal: Adds rollout-controller metrics for SLO evaluator lag/health, monitor fetch errors, and rollbacks by cause; updates dashboard wiring to reference new series and labels.
body:
Context: As part of auto-rollback on SLO breach, we need first-class signals to answer: (1) is the evaluator running on time, (2) are monitor reads failing/stale, and (3) why are rollbacks happening (latency vs error vs unknown). This PR adds internal metrics emitted by rollout-controller and updates dashboard wiring to consume them (panel queries added in the dashboard config in this repo; canonical dashboards/templates are tracked in observability-pack/pr-944).

What changed (high level): Added Prometheus metrics for SLO evaluation loop health, monitor fetch outcomes, and rollback decisions. Added consistent label schema so dashboards/alerts can slice by route/model/region/tier/tenant while keeping cardinality bounded. Updated rollout SLO dashboard wiring to include the new series and to replace an older ad-hoc counter we were using during the spike.

New/updated metrics:
- rollout_slo_evaluator_tick_lag_seconds (histogram): wall clock lag between scheduled evaluator tick and actual run time. Labels: env, region, controller_shard.
- rollout_slo_evaluator_verdict_total (counter): verdict counts by verdict=healthy|breach|unknown. Labels: env, region, verdict, slo_type=latency|error.
- rollout_slo_monitor_fetch_total (counter): attempts by outcome=ok|timeout|error|stale|not_found. Labels: env, region, monitor_provider, outcome.
- rollout_slo_monitor_fetch_latency_seconds (histogram): client latency by monitor_provider.
- rollout_auto_rollback_total (counter): rollbacks executed by cause=latency_breach|error_breach|baseline_regression|manual_override|unknown. Labels: env, region, tenant_tier, cause.
- rollout_auto_rollback_suppressed_total (counter): suppression events by reason=min_traffic|warmup|cooldown|global_rate_limit|monitor_unavailable.

Label/cardinality guardrails:
- tenant is NOT a metric label on any high-volume series; we only label tenant_tier (hosted|dedicated|private) and rollout_scope (route|model|service) to avoid per-tenant explosions.
- route/model labels are only emitted on the decision/rollback series and are normalized through the existing rollout identity helpers.
- monitor_id is intentionally excluded; dashboards should pivot via route/model/region/tier and use links to jump to monitor pages.

Dashboard wiring updates:
- Added panels for evaluator lag (p50/p95), monitor fetch error rate, and rollbacks by cause (stacked) with drilldowns.
- Updated the existing 'Unknown verdicts' panel to use rollout_slo_evaluator_verdict_total{verdict="unknown"} rather than log-based counting.
- Added a panel for suppression reasons to make false-positive / no-op behavior visible during canaries.

Testing:
- Unit tests for metric emission are added around MonitorClient fetch paths (ok/timeout/stale) and evaluator verdict transitions.
- Added a lightweight 'metrics smoke' test to ensure the /metrics endpoint includes the new series (protects against accidental renames).

Operational notes:
- This PR does not change rollback decisioning behavior; it only adds visibility.
- The SRE runbook references will be updated once the dashboard template PR lands (observability-pack/pr-944). For now, this PR wires the internal dashboard JSON used by staging and dogfood.

Rollout plan:
1) Merge + deploy to staging, validate dashboards populate.
2) Enable in dogfood (internal canaries) and validate alert noise (unknown verdicts, monitor failures).
3) Once monitor identity migration (ENG-2322) is complete, we can consider adding per-route rollup panels without fear of label skew.

Screenshots: (none; panels are configured via JSON in repo; see changed files).

Related:
- Linear: ENG-2318
- Monitoring/dashboards: observability-pack/pr-944
- Hotfix for unknown verdict handling: pr-18546
- Support context (false positive rollbacks / monitor staleness): SUP-18457
commits: rollout-controller/metrics: introduce evaluator tick lag + verdict counters
monitor-client: add fetch outcome counters + latency histogram
rollback-executor: emit rollback/suppression counters with bounded labels
dashboards: wire new series into rollout SLO dashboard JSON + panel cleanup
tests: add metrics smoke test + unit coverage for fetch outcomes
review_conversation:
Logan Wright: Can we avoid tenant_id as a label? We got burned before. Also outcome labels should be finite.
Allison Grant (author): Agreed. Removed tenant_id from all series; only tenant_tier remains. Outcome is now one of ok|timeout|error|stale|not_found. Added a test to prevent new outcomes without review.

Benji Okafor: For evaluator lag, can we measure scheduled tick vs start time instead of duration of evaluation? We need to detect backlog.
Allison Grant (author): Done. Added rollout_slo_evaluator_tick_lag_seconds histogram; kept evaluation duration internal for now (can add later if needed).

Miles Thornton: Please add a suppression counter so we can see when we're intentionally not rolling back (min traffic, warmup). This will help explain “why no rollback” during game day.
Allison Grant (author): Added rollout_auto_rollback_suppressed_total with reason labels. Wired into dashboard.

Sergio Costa: Dashboard wiring looks good, but please ensure panel queries work pre-ENG-2322 label migration. Some monitors still miss tier.
Allison Grant (author): Updated queries to default missing tier to "unknown" via label_replace in the dashboard config and added a note in the dashboard description. Once ENG-2322 is complete we can tighten.

Final review:
Logan Wright: Approved
Benji Okafor: Approved (thanks for the cardinality guardrails)
Miles Thornton: Approved
Sergio Costa: Approved
